calls.statement:
WITH x AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT 'dup receipt+line' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts multi-store', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts multi-date', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts mixed staff', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel_id '||coalesce(cast(channel_id AS varchar),'null')||' '||format, count(*) FROM x GROUP BY channel_id, format
UNION ALL SELECT 'qty<=0', count(*) FROM x WHERE quantity<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross-net mismatch', count(*) FROM x WHERE abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_key version mismatch (sale_date outside valid)', count(*) FROM x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key WHERE x.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900),
a AS (SELECT store_id, sale_date, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, sum(net_amount) n FROM f GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT store_id, business_date sale_date, receipts, net_sales_before_returns nb, net_sales, returns_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT 'fact days' k, count(*) v FROM a UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt days', count(*) FROM b
UNION ALL SELECT 'sum fact net', sum(n) FROM a UNION ALL SELECT 'sum rpt net_before', sum(nb) FROM b
UNION ALL SELECT 'sum rpt receipts', sum(receipts) FROM b UNION ALL SELECT 'sum fact receipts', sum(r) FROM a
UNION ALL SELECT 'days mismatching', count(*) FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(store_id,sale_date) WHERE a.r IS DISTINCT FROM b.receipts OR abs(coalesce(a.n,0)-coalesce(b.nb,0))>0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg lines in period', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg not in fact', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load t WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=t.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ts date != sale_date', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND cast(sale_ts_utc AS date)<>sale_date

calls.statement:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT s.format, f.receipt_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS staff, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND s.store_id < 900
 GROUP BY s.format, f.receipt_id)
SELECT format,
 round(avg(net) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff), 2) AS avg_basket_net_ex_staff,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff) AS receipts,
 round(avg(net), 2) AS avg_net_incl_staff,
 round(avg(gross) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff), 2) AS avg_gross_ex_staff
FROM r GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
